sentences.en: Light shines through the large windows outside the picture frame.
sentences.zh: 光线透过外面的大窗户照进来。

sentences.en: He framed the picture he had bought on the street.
sentences.zh: 他把在市场上买来的画框给镶上了。

sentences.en: The price shown in this advertisement only includes the frame.
sentences.zh: 广告上标示的价格只包括框架。
